eyebrow.zh-CN: Medical Navigator · 跨境医疗导航

title.zh-CN: 跨境医疗，从「想清楚」开始

lede.zh-CN: 不看病，不卖项目，只帮你想清楚。
lede.en: We don't treat. We don't sell. We help you think it through.

subtitle.zh-CN: 无论是来华就医还是海外落地，我们都能为您提供专业的医疗导航服务
subtitle.en: Whether seeking healthcare in China or settling abroad, we provide professional medical navigation

desc.zh-CN: 面向海外华人及国际患者，提供来华就医的全流程导航服务。
desc.en: Full-process navigation for overseas Chinese and international patients seeking healthcare in China.

zh-CN: 专科手术与重大疾病诊疗

desc.zh-CN: 面向出国人群，提供海外医疗体系对接与落地服务。
desc.en: Healthcare system integration and settlement services for those moving abroad.

zh-CN: 重症海外就医与二次诊疗意见
en: Serious illness overseas treatment & second opinions

subtitle.zh-CN: 四大板块覆盖跨境医疗的全部核心需求
subtitle.en: Four pillars covering all core cross-border healthcare needs

zh-CN: 海外体检报告解读与对接

subtitle.zh-CN: 我们不替你做决定，但不让你在决定中独自承担风险
subtitle.en: We don't make decisions for you, but we ensure you don't bear the risk alone

desc.zh-CN: 通过深度沟通了解您的健康状况、就医需求和个人偏好，建立完整的需求档案。
desc.en: Through in-depth communication, we understand your health status, medical needs and personal preferences to build a complete profile.

title.en: Assess First, Don't Rush to Connect

desc.zh-CN: 这是我们的核心差异。我们不会急于推荐医院或医生，而是先帮您判断：您的需求是否真的需要跨境医疗？哪种路径最适合您？
desc.en: This is our core differentiator. We don't rush to recommend hospitals or doctors. Instead, we first help you assess: does your situation truly require cross-border healthcare? Which pathway suits you best?

desc.zh-CN: 基于判断结果，为您量身定制医疗方案，包括机构选择、时间规划、费用预估和风险提示。
desc.en: Based on the assessment, we design a tailored medical plan including institution selection, timeline, cost estimation and risk advisory.

desc.zh-CN: 精准匹配合作医疗机构，协调预约、材料准备和跨境手续，确保无缝衔接。
desc.en: Precisely match partner institutions, coordinate appointments, documentation and cross-border procedures for seamless connection.

desc.zh-CN: 从出发到就医到回国，全程提供翻译、陪诊、住宿协调等落地支持服务。
desc.en: From departure to treatment to return, we provide translation, medical escort, accommodation coordination and on-ground support.

desc.zh-CN: 就医结束不是服务终点。我们协助您完成后续随访、报告解读和本地医疗衔接。
desc.en: Treatment completion isn't the end of service. We assist with follow-up, report interpretation and local healthcare continuity.

narrative.zh-CN: 张女士旅居英国期间突发腹痛，当地 GP 建议等待数周排查。我们介入后快速判断情况紧急，协调上海仁济医院国际部，48 小时内完成回国手术安排。从判断到落地，全程陪伴。
narrative.en: Ms Zhang experienced sudden abdominal pain while living in the UK. The local GP suggested waiting weeks for investigation. After our assessment, we determined the urgency, coordinated with Shanghai Renji Hospital International, and arranged return surgery within 48 hours.

quote.zh-CN: 如果不是他们帮我判断了紧急程度，我可能还在等 GP 的排期。
quote.en: Without their urgency assessment, I might still be waiting for the GP appointment.

identity.en: Ms Zhang · Chinese resident in the UK

narrative.zh-CN: 李先生长期在海外工作，希望利用回国假期做一次全面体检。我们根据他的家族病史和职业特点，定制了包含心血管、消化道和肿瘤标志物的深度筛查方案，对接瑞金医院国际医疗平台，三天完成全部检查。
narrative.en: Mr Li, working overseas long-term, wanted a comprehensive check-up during his home visit. Based on his family history and occupation, we designed a deep screening plan covering cardiovascular, gastrointestinal and tumour markers, coordinated with Ruijin Hospital International, completing all tests in three days.

quote.zh-CN: 不是随便做个套餐，而是真的根据我的情况来设计的。
quote.en: It wasn't a generic package — it was truly designed around my situation.

identity.zh-CN: 李先生 · 海外华人企业家

narrative.zh-CN: 王女士术后长期疲劳，西医检查未见异常。我们建议她尝试中西医结合康复路径，对接广慈纪念医院中医科，制定了为期两周的针灸推拿加药膳调理方案。术后三个月，精力明显恢复。
narrative.en: Ms Wang suffered persistent post-operative fatigue with normal Western medical results. We recommended an integrative recovery pathway, coordinating with Guangci Memorial Hospital's TCM department for a two-week acupuncture, massage and medicinal diet programme. Three months later, her energy had noticeably recovered.

quote.zh-CN: 他们没有一上来就推荐最贵的方案，而是先帮我想清楚我到底需要什么。
quote.en: They didn't push the most expensive option — they first helped me figure out what I actually needed.

identity.zh-CN: 王女士 · 术后康复患者
